Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

def transform(grid):
    # Identify the long horizontal separator and the non-background object above it.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    line = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg), None)
    if line is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    obj_rows = [r for r in range(line) if any(v != bg for v in grid[r])]
    if not obj_rows:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = min(obj_rows)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Insert a full-width marker at the object's top, shifting the object down one.
    marker = 8 if any(v == 4 for r in obj_rows for v in grid[r]) else 8
    out[top] = [marker] * w
    for r in range(line-1, top, -1):
        out[r] = grid[r-1][:]
    return out
PY
